```{r}
data <- read.csv("NBA_final (1).csv")
#summary(data)
data <- data[complete.cases(data[, c(8,9,10,21,26,27,28,29,30,31,32,33,34,45)]), ]
dim(data)
```


```{r}
data$Play <- as.factor(data$Play)
model <- lm(data=data, Salary~G+GS+MP+FT+TRB+AST+STL+BLK+TOV+PF+PTS+
              mean_views+Play+mean_views:Play)#chose mean_views:Play as interaction term because
#it could be interesting to see if an increase in views on wikipedia has a different effect
#on salary if the player has already been in an all star game
e_hat<-resid(model)
y_hat<-fitted(model)
summary(model)
```

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=14}
png("pairs_plot.png", width = 800, height = 800, res = 100)
pairs(data[,c(8,9,10,21,26,27,28,29,30,31,32,34,45)])
dev.off()
```

```{r}
pairs(data[,c(8,9,10,21,26,27,28,29,30,31,32,34,45)])
```

```{r, echo=F, fig.width=8, fig.height=11}
par(mfrow=c(4,3))
plot(data$Salary ~ y_hat, ylab="Salary", xlab="Fitted")
plot(e_hat ~ y_hat, ylab="Residuals", xlab="Fitted")
```

```{r, echo=F, fig.width=8, fig.height=11}

for(i in c(8,9,10,21,26,27,28,29,30,31,32,34,45)){

}
```

```{r, echo=F, fig.width=8, fig.height=11}

```

```{r, echo=F, fig.width=3, fig.height=5}

```




```{r}
#log transformation on the response might fix the issue since the response is right skewed
data$lnSalary <- log(data$Salary)
data$lnviews <- log(data$mean_views)
#fit a new model with lnSalary
model2 <- lm(data=data, lnSalary~G+GS+MP+FT+TRB+AST+STL+BLK+TOV+PF+PTS+
              lnviews+Play+lnviews:Play)
e_hat2<-resid(model2)
y_hat2<-fitted(model2)
```




```{r, echo=F, fig.width=8, fig.height=11}
par(mfrow=c(4,3))
plot(lnSalary ~ y_hat2, ylab="lnSalary", xlab="Fitted")
plot(e_hat2 ~ y_hat2, ylab="Residuals", xlab="Fitted")
```



```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=14}
png("pairs_plot.png", width = 800, height = 800, res = 100)
pairs(data[, c("G","GS","MP","FT","TRB","AST","STL","BLK","TOV","PF","PTS","lnviews")])
dev.off()
```


```{r, echo=F, fig.width=8, fig.height=11}
par(mfrow = c(3, 3))

for(i in c("G","GS","MP","FT","TRB","AST","STL","BLK","TOV","PF","PTS","lnviews")){
plot(e_hat2 ~ data[,i], ylab="Residuals", xlab= i)
}
```



```{r}
#apply box-cox on predictors(FT, TRB, AST, TOV, PTS) to fix the constant variance issues
#install.packages("car")
#library(car)
#summary(powerTransform(cbind(data[,c('FT','TRB','AST','TOV', 'PTS')] + 1)))

#apply transfromations on each variable based on results above
data$bcFT <- bcPower(data$FT + 1, -1/2)
data$bcAST <- bcPower(data$AST + 1, -1/3)
data$bcTOV <- bcPower(data$TOV + 1, -1/3)
data$bcPTS <- bcPower(data$PTS + 1, -1/3)
```



```{r}
#fit a new model using transformed response and predictors
model3 <- lm(lnSalary ~ G + GS + bcPTS  + bcFT + TRB + bcAST + STL + BLK + PF +
              lnviews + Play + lnviews:Play, data=data)
summary(model3)

#install.packages("car")   # run once
library(car)
vif(model3)
e_hat3 <- resid(model3)
y_hat3 <- fitted(model3)
```


```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=14}
png("pairs_plot.png", width = 800, height = 800, res = 100)
pairs(data[, c("G","GS","MP","bcFT","TRB","bcAST","STL","BLK","bcTOV","PF","bcPTS","lnviews")])
dev.off()
```


```{r}
library(MASS)
stepAIC(model3, direction = "both", k=2)

```



```{r, echo=F, fig.width=8, fig.height=11}
par(mfrow=c(4,3))
plot(data$lnSalary ~ y_hat3, ylab="lnSalary", xlab="Fitted")
plot(e_hat3 ~ y_hat3, ylab="Residuals", xlab="Fitted")
```


```{r, echo=F, fig.width=8, fig.height=11}
par(mfrow = c(3, 3))

for(i in c("G","GS","MP","bcFT","TRB","bcAST","STL","BLK","bcTOV","PF","bcPTS","lnviews")){
plot(e_hat3 ~ data[,i], ylab="Residuals", xlab= i)
}
```


```{r, echo=F, fig.width=3, fig.height=5}
qqnorm(e_hat3)
qqline(e_hat3)
```


```{r}
# fit a new model excluding the insignificant predictors
reduced <- lm(lnSalary ~ G + MP + TRB + BLK + PF + bcPTS +
              lnviews + Play + lnviews:Play, data=data)
summary(reduced)

anova(reduced, model3)
```


```{r}
# fit a new model excluding the insignificant predictors
reduced1 <- lm(lnSalary ~ G + MP + TRB + BLK  + lnviews + Play + lnviews:Play, data=data)
summary(reduced1)

vif(reduced1)

anova(reduced1, reduced)
```

```{r}
# fit a model as using Play as response
inter <- lm(lnSalary ~ lnviews + Play + lnviews:Play, data = data)
summary(inter)
```


```{r}
# fit a new model excluding the insignificant predictors
reduced2 <- lm(lnSalary ~ G + MP + TRB + BLK, data=data)
summary(reduced2)

anova(reduced2, reduced1)
```
